method: device-login then grant_type=refresh_token with DPoP (4 then 3 successive refreshes)

wallClock.note: Each refresh returned full refresh_expires_in=7776000 from that moment; refreshExpiresAt advanced with each refresh.

conclusion.caveat: YES means sliding 90-day offline window: keep refreshing (and retaining DPoP keys) before the window elapses. Missing the window, revoked offline session, or lost DPoP material requires device re-login. Not immortal without activity.

publicRealmDocNote: GET /realms/floatplane does not publish ssoSessionMaxLifespan / offlineSessionMaxLifespan; lifetimes taken from token endpoint responses only.
